name: ai-maestro-board
description: Shows an agent its own AI Maestro task board inside the terminal: a count in the status line and a /board command that lists the cards by column, with what each waits on and its Eisenhower quadrant. Read-only. Works with the AI Maestro server on the host, or from the board file when no server runs. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or later.

agentId.title: Agent id
agentId.description: Which agent's board to show. Leave empty inside AI Maestro (the session says who it is). Set it for an agent that runs outside AI Maestro, e.g. a lolabot: its AMP identity id.

apiUrl.title: AI Maestro address
apiUrl.description: Where the AI Maestro server of this host listens. Empty means http://localhost:23000 (or AIMAESTRO_API when that is set).

showStatus.title: Show the count in the status line
showStatus.description: Adds e.g. 'board: 4 open, 1 waiting on you' to the status line.
